feeds.title: I Heart Publix Blog
feeds.description: I Heart Publix is a one stop resource for all things related to Publix. You will find complete weekly ads with corresponding coupon match ups. All the Advantage Buy Flyers, the best weekly deal highlights, and all the booklets reported in store. My goal is to help people save time and money by having everything easily accessible.

feeds.title: My Publix Coupon Buddy
feeds.description: Check out the hottest Publix deals each week on our website. My Publix Couponing Buddy breaks down how to do coupon deals just like you're talking to your best friend. Easy step by step directions how to do each Publix and CVS deal.

feeds.title: Moola Saving Mom | Best Publix Deals and Coupons
feeds.description: MoolaSavingMom.com is about spending LESS not just saving MORE. The Best Deals, Coupons, Matchups at Stores Across the Country. Teaching you to use coupons to reduce your spending on everything.

feeds.title: Passionate Penny Pincher | Publix Savings and Coupons Blog
feeds.description: Passionate Penny Pincher is the #1 source printable & online coupons for retailers like Amazon, Walmart, Target & more. Get your promo codes or coupons & save at Publix.

feeds.title: True Money Saver | Publix Couponing Blog
feeds.description: This is a Family Friendly website dedicated to help point you to great deals, sharpen your purchasing skills to help you spend less in order to save money and bless others. Learn to shop smart and save big. Practical solutions to help you stop overspending on groceries, successfully manage your money and conquer debt for good.

feeds.title: My Coupon Expert | Publix Deals
feeds.description: My goal is to encourage, inspire and help you to save money for your family and stay positive. Find out latest Publix deals, coupons and save more. I am a deal finding, money saving frugal mom.

feeds.title: Publix Savings 101 | Hottest Publix Deals and Matchups
feeds.description: We post the HOTTEST Publix deals and early matchups so you can get your coupons ready. This site is dedicated to anyone who would like to learn how to coupon at Publix or to anyone who is new at couponing at Publix.

feeds.title: Coupon Confidants | Publix Deals and Savings Blog
feeds.description: This is a money saving blog that takes pride in helping to save you and your family money. Exclusive Publix deals and coupons to your rescue.
